courses.name: Diploma of Music
courses.area: Music studies.
courses.prerequisites: Refer to the CQUniversity general admission criteria.
courses.fees: Refer to CQUniversity current fee information .
courses.summary: This diploma allows students to focus on a broad range of music styles including western art music, jazz or contemporary music. This exciting course will expose students to a variety of learning experiences including performance tuition to develop their solo performance skills and academic study in the interpretation and understanding of music. This means that students will be supported throughout their study and undertake one-on-one instrumental tuition with highly qualified regional conservatorium staff either through video tuition as an online student or on-campus at the Central Queensland Conservatorium of Music (CQCM), at CQUniversity Mackay. Students will learn foundational aspects of the language of music and gain practical music studies focusing on repertoire and technical work in their chosen instrument, voice or composition. Upon completion, students may choose to continue their study at the second year level in CQUniversity's Bachelor of Music.
courses.careers: Musician; studio teacher; music administration; communication; creative industries.

courses.name: Undergraduate Certificate in Accounting
courses.area: Accounting, business law, economics.
courses.prerequisites: Refer to the CQUniversity general admission criteria.
courses.fees: Refer to CQUniversity current fee information .
courses.summary: The Undergraduate Certificate in Accounting offers you the opportunity to experience University-level studies in fields such as accounting, financial services, and business management. You will learn key accounting and financial services approaches and develop foundational skills that prepare you to become valued accounting professionals. Undergraduate Certificate in Accounting allows you to learn how to build foundation accounting and business management skills and prepares you for the future world of work. The undergraduate certificate also offers an opportunity to acquire new skills or add to existing qualifications. An Undergraduate Certificate in Accounting is a pathway to further study of higher awards, such as a Bachelor of Accounting.
courses.careers: Local, national and global business, accounting or finance sectors in roles such as: administration officer/manager, economics advisor, or consultant
